entities.summary: North Macedonia is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Skopje. Official languages include Macedonian, Albanian (co-official in municipalities with >20% Albanian population). Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 2.0 million. Area: 25,713 km². Comprehensive index for North Macedonia covering ancient Macedon (Alexander the Great, 356-323 BCE), Roman conquest, Byzantine/Bulgarian/Serbian medieval rule, Ottoman conquest (1392-1912, 500+ years), Balkan Wars 1912-13, Vardar Macedonia/Yugoslavia, IMRO (Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation), WWII (Bulgarian occupation, Partisan resistance), Yugoslav Macedonia (1945-91), independence 1991, Greek naming dispute (1991-2019), Prespa Agreement 2018 (renamed to 'North Macedonia'), EU candidate.
